content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Little Rock

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate's degree, or high school diploma affects the experience hours you must document. Verify your qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all 35 required contact hours synchronously with active certified practitioners. Our flexible scheduling accommodates full-time professionals across Little Rock's healthcare, government, financial services, logistics, aerospace, and retail sectors. Register for your preferred cohort start date.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the 35-hour course, complete and submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of education and project experience. Pay the associated examination fee. PMI will review and approve your eligibility before you can schedule your exam with Pearson VUE.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to review the PMBOK® Guide and refine your knowledge. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Plan adequate study time after course completion to build confidence and mastery.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to keep your certification active. PMI offers multiple pathways: continuing education, project experience, teaching, and volunteering. Budget time and resources across each renewal cycle to stay current and demonstrate ongoing commitment to the profession.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
